# Exterior production refinement (owner brief 2026-11-01 21:39Z, thread "Refine Wayfarer exterior for production")

Branch `claude/project-thread-sogbnr` from main 1f9eba1 (longitudinal tanks + Graded Thermal Blade + first-ignition light budget).
Three stages: A the thermal bulkhead's construction, B three permanent hero cameras, C an exterior detail and material pass.
Every new choice here is PROTOTYPE (Claude under the owner's delegation); nothing changes canon, the operating point or a physical budget.

## A. Thermal bulkhead construction

**Function (unchanged):** three specular sheets at the hot blade front (offsets 0.5 / 0.8 / 1.1 m, slopes 0 / 5 / 10 deg, eps 0.12 /
0.08 / 0.05) stop every line of sight from the 1800 K blades to WARM, LOW, the rings and the tank farm, and vent the heat they pick up
sideways to space (V-groove). Layer geometry, spacing, emissivities, areal masses and the study's net factors are untouched.

**Fixed constraints:** full diameter (casing r 6.1 m to r 37 m, the shield shadow); no member aft of layer 1 (nothing structural may see
the blades); no primary thrust load into the bulkhead; the crawler/EVA gate per layer at the casing (closed under thrust); the
district length (44.5 m) and every station forward.

**Design (was a revolved plate per layer; now a tension-membrane wheel):**

| Element | Choice | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Gores | 36 per layer, each 3 replaceable panels between hub, anti-flutter hoops (r 16 / 26 m) and rim: 324 panels | the 36-gore starting point of the GTB study; panel size (largest about 6.5 x 11 m) fits a drone exchange |
| Seams | gores alternate high/low by 0.03 m with a 0.20 m labyrinth overlap; layer 2 seams staggered half a gore | no straight gap; a ray through one seam meets solid foil on the next layer |
| Foil | Mo/TZM 59 um (L1), Ti-6Al-4V 79 um (L2), Ti 78 um with gold both faces (L3), from areal mass / density | the drawn sheets have no thickness; this is the thickness they stand for, so mass and model agree |
| Seam battens | one radial tendon per seam (36 per layer), clip track for the gore edges | gores hang on sliding clips, carry only their own tension |
| Rim | segmented compression ring, 36 segments, sliding sleeve joint each (0.06 m travel) | the foil hems wrap over it (rolled edge) |
| Hub | ring on 12 radial-slot sliding brackets to the casing (0.25 m slide) | layer growth is taken at the hub, the casing stays cool |
| Trusses | 3 tapered C/C trusses in the layer 1-2 gap along the blade planes, depth 0.21 m at the casing to 2.89 m at the rim | where the blades are edge-on anyway; behind layer 1, never in the blades' view; depth grows with the cantilever moment |
| Layer 3 | hangers every 4 m from the WARM aft root boom (already 0.4 m ahead of layer 3, parallel to it) | no extra structure |
| Gates | per blade plane per layer on the SP-51 crawler rail line, 1.40 x 1.60 m, door slides radially outward on two guides | 0.3 m between layers leaves no swing space; aligned along X so the three openings form one passage |

**Checks (radiator_zones.construction, check):**

- Thermal growth from 300 K over the radial span: L1 0.162 m, L2 0.151 m, L3 0.055 m; hub slide 0.25 m >= 1.5 x growth (L1 needs 0.243 m:
  tight but inside). Rim segment growth 34 / 32 / 11 mm; joint travel 60 mm >= 1.5 x.
- Seam leakage: a ray passes a shingled overlap only within atan(0.03/0.20) = 8.5 deg of grazing. Slot aperture about 1.0 % of each
  layer (1,376 m of seam x 0.03 m), diffuse fraction that close to grazing 2.2 %: bound 0.02 % of the flux on a layer, inside the
  study's +-1-2 % ray noise. A ray that passes enters the vented V-gap, which the Monte Carlo already solved as inter-layer exchange,
  and the next layer's seams are staggered. The Monte Carlo was not rerun: the layer surfaces, spacing, slopes and emissivities are
  unchanged, so its assumptions hold.
- Support conduction layer 1 -> 2 through the truss standoffs (39 paths, two zirconia/C-C standoffs in series, G 1.3 mW/K each): 10 W,
  against 60 MW radiated by one face of layer 1 (2e-7). The study's "thermally floating sheets" stays valid.
- Shield-shadow and envelope: everything stays inside r 37 m (rim tube outer edge r 37.09 m, 0.09 m past the sheet edge, inside the 8 m
  shadow margin).
- Gate fit: 1.40 x 1.60 m opening against a 1.00 x 1.00 m passing envelope (suited crew with PLSS, ISS hatch class; DR-EVA-02 crawler
  0.60 m) plus 0.05 m margins: 0.30 / 0.50 m spare.
- Mass: foils 5.83 t (gross area with overlaps), battens, hoops, rims, hubs and gates 2.89 t, trusses 0.54 t, hangers 0.04 t:
  **9.29 t** (8.95 t before; +0.34 t, the overlaps and the explicit hardware).
- Capacities unchanged: WARM 6.16 MW (+23 %), LOW 1.26 MW (+26 %) at maximum drive (radiator_zones.placed; check PASS).

**OPEN (unchanged or new):** foil qualification at 1200 K over years, gore tension and flutter during ignition transients, MMOD
perforation of layer 1, truss and standoff sizing, gate door drive/latch/seal, the gate openings are not cut in the display gores (the
door is drawn closed, the burn pose), drone exchange tooling for a panel.

## B. Hero cameras

`hero_cameras.py` + `[look.hero_cameras]`: focus, direction, lens and fit box from the ship's own stations; poses saved as CAM_HERO_* in
the vehicle file (30_CAMERAS). `presentation/hero_set.py` renders each in engineering (Workbench, functional colours), cinematic (Cycles,
grammar + production families, one sun, black space) and a separate label overlay; FIRST_IGNITION for the propulsion camera (hot faces and
layer 1 as grey bodies). check(): nearest ship part >= 0.25 x ship length (no swollen Brow).

| Camera | Lens | Distance | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CAM_HERO_ENGINEERING | 50 mm | 461 m | whole ship, true proportions, ventral blade nearly face-on |
| CAM_HERO_FORWARD | 40 mm | ~280 m | Brow, EYE wells, tank farm, rings, spine to the bulkhead |
| CAM_HERO_PROPULSION | 35 mm | 312 m | nozzles, HOT blades, bulkhead, WARM/LOW; the First Ignition camera |

## C. Detail and materials

- WARM/LOW sheets: return trunk on the other face, outer edge chord, transverse ribs at the panel-module boundaries (edge-on, 0.025 m
  footprint, at sheet temperature, so they act as fins: no capacity change claimed or needed), guided shoes across the WARM/LOW joint.
- Materials (`[production.exterior.families]`, depiction only): WARM/LOW matte white ceramic (AZ-93 family) in two panel lots; bulkhead
  foils polished Mo, Ti and gold (two lots each); C/C trusses near-black; cryogenic vessels quilted aluminized MLI; insulated transfer
  lines; deck and skirts structure grey; valves and cryocoolers graphite machinery. Surface treatments (`[production.exterior.surface]`):
  foil pillowing, MLI quilting and crinkle, ceramic lot jitter. The coatings' optical data stay in `[radiators.zones]`; a shader
  qualifies nothing. HOT blades keep the dark COAST depiction.
- Not changed in this pass (next milestone): ring exteriors, Brow/EYE, drive and nozzle detail, markings (they already carry the Phase 4
  S3-S6 packs).
